tha-ap348:1.1: Campakapupphiya.] Himavantass' avidūre Cāvalo nāma pabbato / Buddho Sudassano nāma vihāsi pabbatantare. // //
tha-ap348:2.1: Pupphaṃ hemavataṃ gayha gacchaṃ vehāsayen' ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddham oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ. // //
tha-ap348:3.1: Satta campakapupphāni sīse katvān' ahaṃ tadā / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ sayambhussa mahesino. // //
tha-ap348:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap348:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Campakapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
